title: Functional Requirements for Self-Propelled Gantry for Lifting Air Cargo Containers and Outsize Cargoes
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 12462) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Functional Requirements for Self-Propelled Gantry for Lifting Air Cargo Containers and Outsize Cargoes.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Freight Containers - Air/Surface (Intermodal) General Purpose Containers and Tests
Freight Containers - Air/Surface (Intermodal) General Purpose Containers and Tests (IS 7917 (PART 2))
Series 1 Freight Containers - Handling and Securing

clause_3_terminology: Propelled Gantry for Lifting Air Cargo Containers and Outsize Cargoes
Functional Requirements for Self-Propelled Gantry for Lifting Air Cargo Containers and Outsize Cargoes

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
